title: Exploring Frump's Misfortune
description: Exploring Frump's Misfortune — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Explore

Quest Description: Explore many branches connected to Upper Frump's Misfortune and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston. Involves visiting the locations: Deathtroit, Cleaveland and H.E.L.L. A..

Quest Reward: 18750 Gold

Return to: Loremaster Vraile in Townston

Next Quest:Exploring Frump's Misfortune (2)

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Explore the many Branches connected to Upper Frump's Misfortune and Return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

I need someone to go and map out the branches inside Upper Frump's Misfortune. You think you can do that for me?

It's true what they say, 'There is nowhere in the world quite like Frump's Misfortune' but that's just half the story! No one can forget The Frump himself! Talk about someone who has made something from nothing. Then turned it into nothing then something about a dozen times over. Not even male pattern baldness could stop this guy. Let's just say that his combover starts at his ankles and leave it at that!

Return to me, Loremaster Vraile, in Townston when you have mapped out all the intersecting areas of Upper Frump's Misfortune.

Turn-in:

Back for more, eh. Good, because I have more for you to do.

Objectives:

  • Explore Deathtroit
  • Explore Cleaveland
  • Explore H.E.L.L. A.

Level range: 25–45
